title: Maintenance report
description: A service or repair visit to a machine or a piece of equipment.
requirement: Write a maintenance report from what the technician says: the day of the visit, the equipment, the fault or reason for the visit, the work carried out, the parts used, the hours worked and the state the equipment was left in.

fields.name: service_date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day of the maintenance visit.

fields.name: equipment
fields.label: Equipment
fields.description: The machine or equipment that was serviced, with its model or location when stated.

fields.name: fault
fields.label: Fault or reason for visit
fields.description: What was wrong or why the visit was made.

fields.name: parts_used
fields.label: Parts used
fields.description: Spare parts and materials that were used.

fields.name: outcome
fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: The state the equipment was left in.
